answer: Make each new identity post a bonded stake that burns slowly like an ember unless peers it has never transacted with attest real work each epoch. A sybil farm of a thousand hollow keys must keep a thousand embers fed, so cost scales linearly with fake count while honest agents earn the stake back from graded output. Attesters are drawn by a random beacon, like a marble picked blind from a bag, so a ring can't choose its own reviewers to collude.
